title: The Lossy Job Worker
description: Webhook jobs disappear after crashes, batches return early, and retry settings leak between deliveries.
objective: Reproduce the reported failures and repair the implementation without changing its public interfaces.
expectedBehavior: withRetry uses DeliveryError.status (0 = network error) and immutable RetryOptions. Retry only 0, 429, and 5xx; retries is total attempts, delay is milliseconds with exponential backoff. processBatch uses futures/threads, waits for all workers, caps concurrency and preserves input order. Queue callbacks must be thread-safe. Dead-letter failed deliveries durably before ack; dead-letter/ack failure rejects the batch. Return JobResult with res or error. Do not mutate job/options inputs.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
